reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: National AI strategy and partnership membership
themes.definition: Speaker cites national AI achievements such as adopting an AI development strategy, joining the Global Partnership on AI, or AI becoming a national priority topic.
themes.inclusion: Include passages reporting national AI strategies, memberships or the rising importance of AI domestically.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages where AI is only a list item of skills without national policy content.
themes.boundary_cases: Statements that AI is 'becoming an important topic' domestically with youth investment may also be coded AI_YOUTH_EDUCATION.

examples.quote: joined the Global Partnership on Artificial Intelligence and adopted a development strategy in that area back in 2019
digitalization and artificial intelligence are becoming important topics in Serbia, not just in the most developed countries of the world

themes.label: AI listed among national youth talents
themes.definition: AI appears in a long list of fields in which the country's young people excel, without further discussion.
themes.inclusion: Include passages where AI is one item in a list of technologies, skills or sectors.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages describing AI policy or AI impacts.
themes.boundary_cases: If the list is followed by a specific AI policy, code AI_NATIONAL_STRATEGY as well.

examples.quote: blockchain, artificial intelligence, big-data analytics, biology, software development and programming

value.rationale: Serbian passages mention AI as a national point of pride: listed among youth talents, framed as a rising domestic priority, and via an AI strategy and GPAI membership, with no discussion of risks or global governance.
